tools.description: GEOly CLI — sign in to your GEOly account in a browser, then call GEOly tools (brand AI visibility, citation analysis, competitor benchmarks, and public industry intelligence) directly: `geoly-accio-mcp tools` lists them, `geoly-accio-mcp call <tool> --json '<args>'` invokes one. Bundled with the plugin with no external dependencies; it runs on Accio's built-in Node.js runtime and does not download packages from npm.
